questions.q: Which KPI in this lesson is a direct, measured answer to the Lesson 1 incident?
options: Access request response time, targeted at under 10 business days
Quality check pass rate
CDE ownership coverage
None of the KPIs relate to the Lesson 1 incident
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly ties access request response time back to the six-week DSAR delay from Lesson 1, now tracked against a 10-day target.

questions.q: What are the four stages of the issue workflow, in order?
options: Detect, triage, resolve, review
Report, ignore, escalate, delete
Classify, archive, audit, close
Plan, build, test, deploy
questions.explain: The lesson walks through exactly these four stages as the repeatable path every issue follows, from discovery to monthly board reporting.

questions.q: What does the 'triage' stage of the workflow use to classify severity?
options: The Lesson 3 critical data element scoring criteria
A random number generator
Triage has no classification step in this workflow
The employee's seniority level
questions.explain: The lesson states the steward classifies severity using the same regulatory/financial/decision/operational criteria from Lesson 3's CDE scoring.

questions.q: Why did Marcus Ibe propose only five KPIs instead of a much longer list?
options: KPIs are purely symbolic and their number doesn't matter
A short list people actually review monthly is more effective than a long list nobody checks
LTV Global has no other metrics worth tracking
Five is the maximum number SQL Server allows in a single report
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly states the KPI list is deliberately short because a long list nobody checks is worse than a short one people actually review.

questions.q: Where does a decision above a steward's authority, like an authoritative-source dispute, go during the 'resolve' stage?
options: It stays with the steward regardless of authority level
It is resolved by majority vote among all employees
It is automatically deleted from the system
It escalates to the domain owner, following the Lesson 4 RACI
questions.explain: The lesson states that decisions beyond a steward's authority escalate to the owner, consistent with the RACI structure established in Lesson 4.
